title: Owl in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='28' fill='#8B5E3C'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='14' ry='18' fill='#D4A574'/>

  <path d='M44 58 Q50 62 56 58' stroke='#C49564' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='22' fill='#A0704A'/>

  <path d='M32 22 L28 10 L40 20 Z' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <path d='M68 22 L72 10 L60 20 Z' fill='#8B5E3C'/>

  <path d='M56 60 L64 72 L58 74 L52 62 Z' fill='#E03030'/>

  <path d='M30 57 Q50 64 70 57' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>

  <path d='M26 52 Q20 68 28 80 Q34 72 32 58 Z' fill='#7A5030'/>

  <path d='M40 88 L36 94 M40 88 L40 95 M40 88 L44 94' stroke='#FF8C00' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M60 88 L56 94 M60 88 L60 95 M60 88 L64 94' stroke='#FF8C00' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

  <rect x='10' y='90' width='80' height='5' rx='2' fill='#5A3A1A'/>
